claim_text: Pregnancy increases iron requirements, but supplemental iron dose should be coordinated with antenatal guidance and existing prenatal products to avoid duplication or inappropriate treatment.
health_goal_or_outcome: Identify safety constraints and prevent unsupported supplement recommendations.
ingredient_form_or_preparation: Supplement products; verify exact formulation, concentration and label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Iron fact sheet provides pregnancy reference information and safety context.
limitations: No individualized dose; follow local antenatal protocol.
Exact source passages, product-specific labeling and clinical applicability require full appraisal.
